# Narration from the Entry state through the next menu

The narration starts after the delivery iteration's own push to `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. The course `deliver` is already set, so no initial menu renders. No `--rebase` was passed, so no sync step runs.

## 1. Validate the record and the target

- I open `/tmp/gatekeep-state.synthetic`, the path named in the first tracker task.
- I check it against `consent.target`:
  - Base repository: `meadow/events`.
  - PR number: `642`.
  - Base branch: `main`.
- The record holds:
  - Course: `deliver`.
  - Rounds: 1 used of a cap of 6.
  - Syncs: 0 used of a cap of 6.
  - `repair.poll_deadline`: null.
  - Assessed head: `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`.
  - Scope: `source: pr`, original intent "reject unsigned events".
- The record is valid and the target matches. I reset nothing.

## 2. Delivery step 4: Exit check before any watch

The Exit check reads the last helper result and the retained failed prerequisites first, before any watch on pending CI.

- The implementer returned `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff`.
- The pre-push reviewer's closure line kept P1 open with the same reason.
- That matches the row "Helper open - needs \<what\>", so the course exits now with `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff`.
- The exit names only the prerequisite and adds no CI-timeout wording.

Because the exit fires first:
- No watch deadline is set; `repair.poll_deadline` stays null.
- No `gh pr checks --watch` runs.
- No implementer is re-dispatched with the unchanged payload.
- No round or sync is charged.
- Local commits are kept.

## 3. Read-only refresh before the menu

The own-push re-render steps still run, because a menu always requires a fresh read first.

1. `gh pr view 642 --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,body,baseRefName,number,title,author,isDraft,headRefName,isCrossRepository,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,url,mergeCommit`
   - Head: `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`, unchanged.
   - State: OPEN; `mergeable`: MERGEABLE; merge state: CLEAN.
   - Body and base (`main`) are unchanged.
2. `gh run list -R meadow/events -c 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`
   - Run 910 (`ci`) is `in_progress`.
   - `ci / test` is a check run whose matching run is not completed, so it is a binding pending check.
   - The evidence remains `source: pending` on the assessed head.
3. Comment fetches:
   - `gh api repos/meadow/events/pulls/642/comments --paginate` returns nothing.
   - `gh api repos/meadow/events/issues/642/comments --paginate` returns nothing.
   - Compared with the comment ledger, there are no new, edited, or withdrawn comments and no change to reconcile.
   - No reviewer workflow is known, so no reviewer-run list is read.

## 4. Helpers dispatched

None in this stretch:
- No implementer, because the prerequisite is unchanged.
- No pre-push or comment-change reviewer, because nothing changed.
- No claim-check helper, because CI has not finished on the assessed head.

## 5. Tracker

- At the start of the run, `plan_tracker` was initialized with `gather, provision, verify`, with `state: /tmp/gatekeep-state.synthetic` in the first task's name. There were no sync stages because `--rebase` was absent.
- This re-entry reopens `report`, then `menu`.

## 6. Assessed SHA

Both verification and the brief assess `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`.

## 7. Sync line

None renders, because `--rebase` was not passed.

## Rendered report and first menu

```
Delivers: the guard rejects unsigned events.

PR comments:
- The ci / test check is still running on the assessed head, so merge waits. (ci / test)

Blockers:
1. The remaining fix needs an edit to src/guard.ts outside this PR's diff, so the repair wave left it open and the rejected path is not yet proven. (src/guard.ts)

Evidence: CI pending (run 910, ci / test in progress on 2222222)

Verdict: stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff

Pick one:
1. deliver - resume the retained course; the repair retries once src/guard.ts outside the diff is available, no round charged; add 6 to each cap (+2 x 3; rounds 1 of 6 -> 12, syncs 0 of 6 -> 12).
2. assess - switch course and post the open blocker as a review comment; no repairs.
3. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is. [recommended]

Not offered: merge (ci / test pending), approve (own PR).
Type a number; show evidence prints the full record (CI pending, run 910, ci / test in progress on 2222222).
```

The Exit check therefore selects `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` before any CI watch, deadline creation, repair dispatch, or sync.

   I dispatch no helper. In particular, I do not retry the implementer, run the verification command, or ask a reviewer to reconsider the unchanged prerequisite.

   ```sh
   gh pr view 642 --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,body,baseRefName,number,title,author,isDraft,headRefName,isCrossRepository,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,url,mergeCommit
   ```

4. I run the tracked-clean check:

   ```sh
   git -C .worktrees/pr-642 status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
   ```

   It is empty. I persist the retained failed prerequisite and obstacle outcome in the existing run record without changing course, counters, or deadline. I complete `report` and add/start `menu`.

   Verification evidence and the brief's assessment are bound to `2222222222222222222222222222222222222222`. Evidence remains `pending`; no local verification runs. No `Sync:` line renders because the invocation did not include `--rebase`.

   The first menu from this continuation is the obstacle template. Delivery remains available, but selecting it would extend each cap by `6`, not clear the unchanged prerequisite or authorize a blind retry.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the intended move: the Exit check reads the helper's `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` before any watch, exits with `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff`, charges nothing, dispatches nothing, and renders the obstacle menu with numeric deliver and assess, stop recommended last, and no wait/fix rows; Before instead rendered an ordinary `fixable` verdict with wait and fix rows, so f1 and f3 failed there while f2 (no watch, no repeat helper) already held. The one spot worth tightening in After is deliver row 1: 'the repair retries once src/guard.ts outside the diff is available ... add 6 to each cap' can be read as if the cap extension itself re-enables the attempt. Phrase it as something like 'deliver - resume the retained course; extends both caps (+2 x 3; rounds 1 of 6 -> 12, syncs 0 of 6 -> 12) but the extension alone does not clear the unchanged prerequisite; the wave re-dispatches only when src/guard.ts outside the diff becomes available' so the 'extension alone cannot clear it' clause is explicit in the row rather than inferred, while keeping the exit-before-watch ordering, zero dispatch, and the deliver/assess/stop layout as written.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the intended course model cleanly: step 2 reads the retained `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` result and exits `stuck - needs ...` before any watch, deadline, repair, or sync (f1), dispatches no helper and only does the read-only refresh and tracked-clean check before rendering the obstacle (f2), and the obstacle menu is exactly deliver/assess/stop with stop recommended last, no wait/fix/review rows, evidence as a hint, and an explicit note that cap extension cannot clear the unchanged prerequisite (f3). Before already avoided watching and redispatching (so f2 held there too), but it treated the needs result as an ordinary `fixable - 1 blocker` verdict with wait and fix rows and a recommended fix, which is what f1 and f3 moved on. Nothing in After regressed a fact Before kept; the one thing worth tightening is that After's step 3 still says the pending check 'does not override the earlier missing-prerequisite exit' while also stating CLEAN — keep that framing (obstacle precedence over pending evidence) explicit in the wording so the stuck exit always precedes evidence rendering, and keep the deliver row's 'no round charged ... add 6 to each cap' phrasing, since it is what makes the extension-cannot-clear claim legible to the reader.
